subject: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: partners@cloudbridge.io, Matt Gonzales <matt@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)

Hi Matt / CloudBridge team,

Thanks for jumping on this. We're excited to get CloudBridge live on AWS with a Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) so you can resell Redwood Dedicated to your customers with marketplace billing. Attached is our CPPO enablement checklist and the initial pricing matrix.

High-level asks to get started: 
- Can you complete the entity & billing worksheet (attached) and return by EOD Wednesday?
- Confirm which SKUs you want listed (we included proposed SKUs in the CSV).
- Provide preferred PO / procurement contact and the reseller tax/VAT entity name for the DocuSign PO.

Next steps from our side: Ben will own entitlements setup and Vivek will work pricing/partner margin. Once entity info is in we'll kick off the AWS private-offer creation and route for AWS approval (Elena will be looped in).

Attachments: redwood-cppo-enablement-checklist.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix-v3.csv, CloudBridge-entity-form.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to a quick cadence this week.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189
From: Matt Gonzales <matt@cloudbridge.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2027-07-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)

Thanks Stephanie — excited to move quickly. Quick notes: 
1) I'll fill out the entity form and return by COB Wednesday; attaching a draft with our finance lead's comments.
2) SKUs: we want the Dedicated-1 and Dedicated-3 to start. Can you confirm whether Dedicated-3 supports burst capacity? Our first customer needs occasional bursts and we want the SKU to reflect that in the offering.
3) Billing contact: sarah.finance@cloudbridge.io.

Question on margins: do we need a signed reseller agreement before the CPPO is created in the AWS console, or can we create the private offer and sign the reseller contract in parallel? Our procurement prefers to have the PO route linked to an active private offer record.

Forwarding: see attached CloudBridge-entity-form_completed.xlsx (draft) and a short comment doc.

—Matt
Matt Gonzales
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Resell
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Gonzales <matt@cloudbridge.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)

Stephanie / team — thanks Matt. Short answers: 
- Dedicated-3 supports configured burst via burst-capacity flag; we'll surface that as a SKU attribute in the CPPO. I'll add a note in the pricing CSV and set the default max burst to 2x.
- Reseller agreement: we can proceed to create the AWS private offer record with a placeholder contract, but AWS will want the reseller entity and supporting docs to finalize. In practice we create the offer, get AWS approval, then finalize contract signing — that sequence keeps go-live time short.

Action items for us:
- Ben: update pricing matrix + SKU attributes (ETA EOD today).
- Vivek: draft a short reseller Addendum for CloudBridge that covers entitlements and billing flow (ETA 48h).
- Lauren: coordinate DocuSign workflow for the PO + reseller agreement.

Matt — we'll align after we update the CSV and the entity form you returned.

—Ben
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Matt Gonzales <matt@cloudbridge.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)

Matt / Team — attaching a draft reseller addendum and a short runbook for entitlement provisioning. A couple of clarifications: 
- Entitlements: for Channel CPPOs we map AWS buyer account IDs to SKU entitlements; the reseller will still receive marketplace invoice with a split we control via the private-offer allocation.
- Billing cadence: our preferred flow is monthly invoicing via AWS Marketplace, settlement to reseller per agreed margin terms; we can do net-30 split or immediate pass-through depending on CloudBridge preference.
- DocuSign: Lauren, please create two DocuSign envelopes: 1) reseller agreement + addendum, 2) PO/ordering document with payee set to CloudBridge entity.

Attachments: redwood-reseller-addendum-draft.docx, entitlement-provisioning-runbook.pdf

—Vivek
Director, Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@amazon.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Matt Gonzales <matt@cloudbridge.io>
Date: 2027-07-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: AWS CPPO enablement with CloudBridge (marketplace co-sell)

Hi all — quick confirmation from the AWS CPPO team: 
- CloudBridge is eligible to be listed as a Channel Reseller for private offers.
- Please submit the private-offer payload via the AWS Marketplace private offers console (link below) and tag the offer with the partner ID provided below. That accelerates our review.
- Required docs for approval: reseller entity registration, reseller MSA (signed or in-signature), and SKU mapping table.

AWS console link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/private-offers/console/offer/ABC12345
Partner ID to tag: partner-CHBRG-9982

Once you submit, ping me and I'll queue our approvals team for an expedited review (48–72 hours typical).

—Elena
AWS Partner SA, Channel Operations
